title: 医療チーム男女差分
subject: 医療チーム男女差分
subject_en: A small gender-balanced Japanese medical cast: female doctor with black ponytail, male nurse with short black hair, and pharmacist with glasses, white and pale teal uniforms, coloring-page line art with black outline only, calm soft faces, no real person or existing character. Always the same face, hairstyle and outfit.
lead: 医療現場の基本動作を、ぬりえにも使える線画タッチでそろえた素材です。診療、服薬、受付、感染対策、院内案内の説明に向いています。検索結果でも用途が伝わりやすいです。
